clues: Whoever is known for rolls is exactly five years older than whoever is known for brownies.
Ruben is either 75 or 80 years old.
The baker known for brownies is younger than Emil.
Emil and the baker in the white apron are two different people: one is 70, the other 80.
Whoever bakes in the plaid apron is younger than Gus.
The baker whose specialty is gingerbread is neither 70 nor 75 years old.
The baker in the striped apron is exactly 20 years younger than the one known for fudge.
Gingerbread is the specialty of either Emil or Lou.
Either Lou or Mabel bakes in the blue apron.
One of the 70-year-old and the 80-year-old wears the flowered apron, and the other wears the white one.
hints: Clue 7 pins two ages at once. Then look at clues 4 and 10: what do they say about the 70- and 80-year-olds?
Clue 4 makes Emil 70 or 80, and clue 10 puts those two ages in flowered and white. Clue 2 leaves Ruben two ages: test one of them with a Suppose.
Suppose Ruben is 80. Then Emil is 70 (clue 4), the two wear flowered and white (clue 10), and clues 9, 5 and 7 leave Gus no apron.
With Ruben at 75, clues 9 and 10 make blue 65, so Ruben wears plaid. Emil wears flowered, Gus white, and clue 5 makes Gus 80.

solution.key_idea: Supposing Ruben is 80 hands Emil and Ruben the flowered and white aprons, leaving Gus none; so Ruben is 75.
steps: Clue 7 puts the striped apron at 60 and fudge at 80. Clue 5 keeps Gus off 60, so Gus's apron is not striped.
Clue 2 makes Ruben 75 or 80; clue 4 makes Emil 70 or 80. Clue 10 gives the 70- and 80-year-olds the flowered and white aprons.
Suppose Ruben is 80. Then Emil is 70 (clue 4), so between them they wear the flowered and white aprons (clue 10).
But then Gus has no apron left: not blue (clue 9), not plaid (clue 5), not striped. So Ruben is 75.
Clue 10 keeps blue and plaid off 70 and 80, and clue 9 keeps blue off Ruben. So blue is 65, and Ruben wears plaid.
Emil, not in white (clue 4), wears flowered, so Gus wears white. Clue 5 makes Gus 80, with the fudge; Emil is 70.
Clue 6 keeps gingerbread off Emil, at 70, so clue 8 gives it to Lou. Clues 3 and 1 keep brownies off Emil and Ruben.
Mabel has the brownies; the rolls, Emil's or Ruben's, are 70 or 75. So clue 1 makes Mabel 65, in blue, and gives Emil the rolls. Lou is 60.
solution.epilogue: Lou's own oven had died mid-batch, so Lou used Rosa's spare key at midnight to finish gingerbread lighthouses for Hattie's holiday supper. Rosa forgave everything and asked for the icing recipe.

answer_line: Lou baked the gingerbread at midnight.
